summary: Marcus and Erik present 16 stock pitches for their 2025 portfolio, eventually selecting 8 holdings. The focus is on finding attractive risk-reward opportunities with potential for 30% returns during the year. Many of the companies are underperformers or have been punished by the market, offering good entry points.
